qualification.details: Store Keeper cum Accountant: Graduate in Commerce/Economics or equivalent or CA/ICWA Inter. Must be proficient in MS Office/Tele and computer/web based software. Minimum 3 years experience in accounts and bookkeeping in government/semi-government institution or Chartered Accountant firm or 3 years as Article Clerk. Desirable: Knowledge of English and Hindi. Cook: 8th Pass. Minimum 3 years experience as Cook in government/semi-government/private reputed institution. House Keeper: 5th Pass. Minimum 2 years experience as 4th class employee in government/semi-government/private reputed institution.

Download the application form from the official website: www.mahasamund.gov.in.

Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WCD Mahasamund Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.mahasamund.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Mahasamund recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the WCD Mahasamund recruitment is 09-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers positions for Store Keeper cum Accountant, Cook, and House Keeper. Each post has specific educational qualifications and experience requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all the posts. Age relaxation is applicable as per Chhattisgarh Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for WCD Mahasamund recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the creation of a merit list based on educational qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for WCD Mahasamund jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7944/- to Rs. 18536/- per month, depending on the specific post. The Store Keeper cum Accountant post offers the highest salary.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications for the Store Keeper cum Accountant post?
faq.answer: For the Store Keeper cum Accountant position, candidates need to be Graduates in Commerce/Economics or CA/ICWA Inter, with proficiency in MS Office/Tele and computer software, and at least 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mahasamund district, www.mahasamund.gov.in. The direct link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates with the application form.
